title: Flock map
description: Where every sheep wearing a collar is, and which ones need someone to walk over.

live.noPositions: No positions yet. A collar sends its first one within 15 minutes of being switched on.

empty.title: No trackers fitted yet
empty.description: Import the seller's list of collars with the ear tag each one went on, and the flock appears here.

trackers.animalHint: The animal's ear tag, RFID or QR code. A tracker of the same kind on that animal comes off.
trackers.removeDescription: Its readings stay in the animal's history. The tracker becomes free for another animal.
trackers.emptyDescription: Collars and boluses appear here once imported.

import.title: Import trackers
import.description: Paste the list from the seller or a spreadsheet. It is checked first, and nothing changes until every line is right.
import.listHint: DevEUI, then the ear tag of the animal it is on. Optionally the kind between them: collar, bolus or ear_tag.
import.defaultKind: Kind, where a line does not say
import.allGood: Every line is right. Press Import to save.
import.tooMany: At most {{max}} lines at a time.

passport.noTrackerHint: Fit a collar or a bolus, and its location, activity and temperature appear here.
passport.removed: The tracker was taken off. Its history is below.
passport.flaggedHint: Raised by the health rules. Go and look at her: a tracker cannot diagnose.
passport.noTemperature: No temperature readings. Only a rumen bolus measures it.
passport.noHistory: The first day's summary appears the morning after.

errors.INVALID_EXTERNAL_ID: This is not a DevEUI (16 hex digits) or a serial number.
errors.EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN: This id is already used by another device or farm.
errors.TRACKER_KIND_MISMATCH: This tracker is registered as a different kind.
errors.ANIMAL_NOT_FOUND: No animal with this tag on the farm.
errors.ANIMAL_NOT_ON_FARM: This animal is no longer on the farm.
errors.DUPLICATE_ANIMAL: This animal would get two trackers of the same kind.
errors.TRACKER_ALREADY_FITTED: This tracker is already on this animal.
errors.TRACKER_ALREADY_REMOVED: This tracker was already taken off.
errors.REMOVED_BEFORE_FITTED: A tracker cannot come off before it was fitted.
errors.INVALID_UPLINK: The message has no device id.
errors.NOT_A_TRACKER: This device is not an animal tracker.
errors.INVALID_READING_TIME: The reading's time is in the future.
errors.INVALID_RANGE: The start must be before the end.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LONG: At most 31 days at a time.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date is in the future.
